description: Git Hook Integration for Incremental Graph Updates — wire repo-graph update into git pre-commit and post-checkout hooks
deviation_notes: Binary-naming gap (Review-A): package.json name is 'repo-graph' but the bun compile target in package.json is `./bin/build-graph`. The spec's hook scripts call `repo-graph update graph.db`, while the actual binary built by `bun run build` is `./bin/build-graph`. Workaround: install the same binary under both `~/.local/bin/build-graph` and `~/.local/bin/repo-graph` so the generated hooks resolve the command regardless of which name the user invokes. The binary itself internally uses the literal 'build-graph' as the help banner text, so `repo-graph --help` displays 'build-graph — Knowledge graph builder…' — this is a cosmetic mismatch that a future track can address by renaming the source filename to `repo-graph.ts` and updating the compile target. Not blocking acceptance.
